usedFor: A QuickBooks invoice registers the billed client for a Zoom webinar.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in QuickBooks, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: An invoice for paid training is the cue to seat that person in the webinar.

watchOut: “New Invoice” fires on every QuickBooks invoice, so narrow it before “Register Attendee for Webinar” runs.
